cards.ex: The museum offers a 'living history' exhibit where actors recreate daily life in the 18th century.
cards.exUz: Muzeyda 'jonli tarix' ko'rgazmasi bor, unda aktyorlar 18-asrda kundalik hayotni qayta yaratadilar.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy davrni qayta jonlantirish, undagi hayotni ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: Every year, we pay homage to our ancestors by visiting their graves.
cards.exUz: Har yili, biz ajdodlarimizning qabrlarini ziyorat qilib, ularga hurmat bajo keltiramiz.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir yoki nimagadir hurmat ko'rsatish, ta'zim qilish.

cards.ex: New York City is a cultural melting pot, with people from all over the world living there.
cards.exUz: Nyu-York shahri - bu madaniy qozon, u yerda butun dunyo odamlari yashaydi.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar aralashib, yangi madaniyat hosil qiladigan joy.

cards.ex: The site has great historical significance because it was the location of a key battle.
cards.exUz: Bu joy muhim jang joylashganligi sababli katta tarixiy ahamiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning o'tmish uchun muhimligi, tarixga ta'siri.

cards.ex: The tradition can be traced back to ancient times.
cards.exUz: Bu an'ananing kelib chiqishini qadimgi davrlarga borib taqaladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning qayerdan boshlanganini aniqlash, ildizini topish.

cards.ex: Using typewriters is now a thing of the past, with computers being so common.
cards.exUz: Kompyuterlar shu qadar keng tarqalganligi sababli, yozuv mashinkalaridan foydalanish hozirda o'tmishda qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi kunda yo'q bo'lgan narsa, o'tmishga tegishli.

cards.ex: Marilyn Monroe is a cultural icon of the 1950s.
cards.exUz: Marilyn Monroe 1950-yillarning madaniy ramzi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror madaniyat uchun katta ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan shaxs yoki narsa.

cards.ex: The story was passed down from father to son.
cards.exUz: Bu hikoya otadan o'g'ilga meros qilib o'tkazilgan.
cards.uzDef: Avloddan-avlodga o'tkazish, meros sifatida berish.

cards.ex: Protecting our cultural heritage is important for future generations.
cards.exUz: Madaniy merosimizni himoya qilish kelajak avlodlar uchun muhim.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdan qolgan va qadrlanadigan urf-odatlar, an'analar va yodgorliklar.

cards.ex: The exact origins of the ritual are lost in the mists of time.
cards.exUz: Marosimning aniq kelib chiqishi vaqt qa'rida yo'qolgan.
cards.uzDef: Juda uzoq o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan, eslash qiyin.

cards.ex: The university promotes cultural exchange programs for students.
cards.exUz: Universitet talabalar uchun madaniy almashinuv dasturlarini rag'batlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar o'rtasida g'oyalar, san'at va urf-odatlarni bo'lishish.

cards.ex: The classic novel has stood the test of time and is still popular today.
cards.exUz: Klassik roman vaqt sinovidan o'tdi va bugungi kunda ham mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan o'z ahamiyatini saqlab qolish, bardosh berish.

cards.ex: The Eiffel Tower is a famous historical landmark in Paris.
cards.exUz: Eyfel minorasi Parijdagi mashhur tarixiy joydir.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan muhim joy yoki bino.

cards.ex: We must keep the memory of the war alive.
cards.exUz: Urush xotirasini saqlab qolishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Unutilishga yo'l qo'ymaslik, mavjudligini ta'minlash.

cards.ex: Folk music is a living tradition in many parts of the world.
cards.exUz: Folk musiqa dunyoning ko'p joylarida tirik an'ana hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi kunda ham amalda bo'lgan va o'tkaziladigan an'ana.

cards.ex: The photograph showed a scene from a bygone era.
cards.exUz: Surat o'tgan davrdagi manzarani ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishda bo'lgan, hozirgi kunda yo'q bo'lgan davr.

cards.ex: Many young people have lost touch with their cultural roots.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yoshlar o'z madaniy ildizlari bilan aloqani uzgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan aloqani yo'qotish, unutish.

cards.ex: The country played a significant role on the world stage during the war.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat urush davrida jahon sahnasida muhim rol o'ynadi.
cards.uzDef: Butun dunyo e'tiborida, xalqaro miqyosda.

cards.ex: The festival celebrates the community's cultural identity.
cards.exUz: Festival jamiyatning madaniy o'zligini nishonlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Bir shaxsning yoki guruhning madaniyat bilan bog'liq bo'lgan o'ziga xosligi.

cards.ex: We must build on the past successes to create a better future.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi kelajak yaratish uchun biz o'tmishdagi muvaffaqiyatlarga asoslanishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi yutuqlardan foydalanib, rivojlanishni davom ettirish.

cards.ex: The wedding ceremony followed many time-honored traditions.
cards.exUz: To'y marosimi ko'plab qadimiy an'analarga rioya qildi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan va qadrlanadigan an'ana.

cards.ex: The opera house is a cultural landmark in the city.
cards.exUz: Opera teatri shahardagi madaniy yodgorlikdir.
cards.uzDef: Madaniyat uchun katta ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan joy yoki bino.

cards.ex: Her family's roots run deep in this community.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasining ildizlari bu jamiyatda chuqur.
cards.uzDef: Biror joy bilan uzoq va kuchli bog'liqlik, kelib chiqishi.

cards.ex: The museum offers a glimpse into the past with its historical artifacts.
cards.exUz: Muzey tarixiy artefaktlari bilan o'tmishga nazar solish imkonini beradi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmish haqida qisqacha ma'lumot olish, o'tmishga bir ko'z tashlash.

cards.ex: Understanding the historical perspective is crucial for analyzing current events.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi voqealarni tahlil qilish uchun tarixiy nuqtai nazarni tushunish juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Voqealarni o'tmish kontekstida tushunish, tarixiy jihatdan baholash.

cards.ex: The country stands at the crossroads, facing critical choices about its future.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat o'z kelajagi haqida muhim tanlovlar oldida chorrahada turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim qaror qabul qilish kerak bo'lgan vaziyatda, hal qiluvchi paytda.

cards.ex: The company promotes cultural awareness among its employees.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'z xodimlari o'rtasida madaniy xabardorlikni targ'ib qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar haqida ma'lumotga ega bo'lish, ularni hurmat qilish.

cards.ex: The historical facts are set in stone and cannot be altered.
cards.exUz: Tarixiy faktlar qat'iy belgilangan va o'zgartirilishi mumkin emas.
cards.uzDef: O'zgartirilmaydigan, qat'iy qoidaga aylangan.

cards.ex: The musician is a cultural ambassador for his country.
cards.exUz: Musician o'z mamlakati uchun madaniy elchi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z madaniyatini boshqa mamlakatlarda tanishtiradigan va targ'ib qiladigan shaxs.

cards.ex: This event will go down in history as a turning point.
cards.exUz: Bu voqea tarixga burilish nuqtasi sifatida kiradi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim voqea sifatida tarixda qolish, xotirada saqlanib qolish.
